scripts:
set ACL on /content/dam
 allow jcr:all for dam-workspace-admin
 end
# 3. Contributor Root Navigation (Folder read, block direct assets)

set ACL on /content/dam
 allow jcr:read for dam-workspace-contributors
 deny jcr:read for dam-workspace-contributors restriction(rep:glob,/*)
 end
# 4. Contributor Workspace Folder Navigation (Folder read, block direct assets)

set ACL on /content/dam/workspace
 allow jcr:read for dam-workspace-contributors
 deny jcr:read for dam-workspace-contributors restriction(rep:glob,/*)
 end

set ACL on /content/dam/workspace/uploads
 allow jcr:read,jcr:addChildNodes,jcr:modifyProperties,jcr:removeChildNodes,jcr:removeNode for dam-workspace-contributors
 end
# 6. Custom Metadata Schemas & UI Consoles Access

set ACL on /conf
 allow jcr:read for dam-workspace-contributors
 end

set ACL on /apps
 allow jcr:read for dam-workspace-contributors
 end

set ACL on /libs
 allow jcr:read for dam-workspace-contributors
 end

set ACL on /etc
 allow jcr:read for dam-workspace-contributors
 end

set ACL on /var
 allow jcr:read,jcr:modifyProperties,jcr:addChildNodes for dam-workspace-contributors
 end
